description: This file contains Python code for generating external function code for PyTorch's JIT, including parsing YAML files, generating C++ function declarations, and writing to files.

methods.name: num_leading_spaces
methods.description: Calculates the number of leading spaces in a line.

methods.name: deindent
methods.description: Removes the minimum leading spaces from all lines in a block of code.

methods.name: gen_external
methods.description: Generates external function code based on YAML definitions and writes to a specified file.
